attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.4 Rear turn lamps follow the requests**

RearLight shall light Lamp_RearLeftTurn while LeftTurnLightRequest is 1 and Lamp_RearRightTurn while RightTurnLightRequest is 1, as received in each TurnLightControl frame.

It shall add no flashing, filtering or timing of its own.

description: Allocated to building block RearLighting. Same follow obligation as FrontLighting, for the rear lamps, so that front and rear lamps flash from the same frame.
